property_summary: For any callee address that causes the low-level call to revert, the reference contract's forward(...) call itself reverts (propagates failure), whereas the mutant inverts the success flag and will instead NOT revert for those failing callees; the test fuzzes a boolean deciding whether the helper should revert to expose this difference.
change_summary: Invert the boolean returned by the call by storing !(_s) into _s before require, making require(!_s) effectively require(original success to be false) (alternative form that changes behavior similarly).
